entries.text: Osu! Let’s do this![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_first_00

entries.text: It’s the one, the only, the hot-blooded Dendra!\nLet’s set our fighting spirits ablaze—together![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_first_01

entries.text: Osu, new kid! So you’re the one who invited me\nhere, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_00

entries.text: A new challenge, in a new place... I’m all pumped\nup and ready to get going![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_01

entries.text: But there must be a reason why you chose me\nof all people to come all the way out here![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_02

entries.text: Go on then—what d’ya need from me, new kid?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_03

entries.text: I wanna see that hot-bloodedness!
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_01

entries.text: I’d like for you to impart some wisdom!
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_02

entries.text: I just wanted to hang out
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_03

entries.text:
I see! Well, you’ve got the right person, new kid!
That’s my specialty!\c
I’ll bring the ocean surrounding this school to a
nice boil with my hot-blooded battling![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04

entries.text:
Oho! Looks like my battle studies wisdom is in
demand here!\c
Guess I shouldn’t be surprised, since this school
prioritizes battling so much![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04b

entries.text: What’re you on about?! I came here for some\ngood battling, not teatime and chats by the\r\nwater cooler![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04c

entries.text: In any case, I’ll do my best! Leave it to the\nhot-blooded Dendra![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_05

entries.text: Don’t worry, you’re in good hands! Like, a\nHariyama’s hands! Y’know how tough those are![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_06

entries.text: Hey, new kid! Man, that Terarium sure is\nsomething![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_00

entries.text: It’s kinda like the Blueberry version of our own\nacademy’s schoolyard, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_01

entries.text: All that open space is so liberating! It’s perfect\nfor long-distance running![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_02

entries.text: For my next class, I’m thinking of having\neveryone run a lap around the Terarium...\r\nWhat do you think?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_03

entries.text: Good idea!
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_select_01

entries.text: I dunno...
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_select_02

entries.text: That’s right! It’s a great way to warm up before a\nleg day workout. What could possibly go wrong?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_04

entries.text: You’re right, it might be a bit much... Guess I’m\njust itching to go for a run!\c\nOh well... OK, fine, just half a lap, then![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_04b

entries.text: So...I’ll see you there, right? Of course I will![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_05

entries.text: Man, the students here sure are fired up![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_00

entries.text: Especially the kiddos taking battle studies.\nThey’re always in the zone![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_01

entries.text: Y’know, I heard that you get more credits here\nfor battle-related courses! Maybe that’s why\r\nthey’re so on top of their game?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_02

entries.text: I mean, it makes sense! If you’re really good at\nbattling, you’ve got a future as a ranger, as a pro\r\nTrainer, or working in the League![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_03

entries.text: So many possibilities!
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_select_01

entries.text: Wait, for real?!
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_select_02

entries.text: And of course, you could even become a battle\nstudies instructor like yours truly![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_04

entries.text: Oho! You didn’t know?!\c\nSo you became a Champion just because you\ncould?! That’s true dedication to Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_04b

entries.text: Well, battle studies or not, putting your best\neffort into studying is important! A whole world\r\nof opportunities opens up for you if you do![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_05

entries.text: Make the most of your time in school while you\ncan, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_06

entries.text: Ah, didn’t mean to get all preachy on you![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_00

entries.text: Y’know, I’m kinda curious about you, new kid—\nas your teacher and fellow competitor![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_01

entries.text: I know! What do you say to trading Pokémon\nso we can get to know each other better?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_02

entries.text: All right! Let’s get started! I’ve got a Meditite!\nWhat about you, new kid?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x1303(0001,0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)]! Nice choice—I can really
feel
its
osu-ness!\c
I’ll train it every day and get it nice and strong![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So you’ll trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for\nmy\r\nMeditite?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Ms. Dendra a Pokémon if you\naren’t its original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Ms. Dendra such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Ms. Dendra a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_03

entries.text:
Wait, we can’t trade if you’ve only got one
Pokémon in your party!\c
Make sure you’ve got at least two Pokémon
in your party and come see me again! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_03_00

entries.text: Oh, maybe not right now, eh? Lemme know when\nyou’re up to trade! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_03_01

entries.text: Osu, new kid!\c\nWhaddya say—feel like doing a trade with me\nnow?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_04_00

entries.text: Osu, new kid! Do I smell an invitation to battle?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_talkto_00

entries.text: Hoho! Guess my nose led me astray... Well, you\nknow I’m up for a battle anytime you feel like it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_cancel_00

entries.text: Well, that’s an invite I simply can’t turn down!\nC’mon—I’ll race you to the battle court![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: Oh, that stings! And you really trounced me, too![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: But hey, at least I learned a lot! I’m gonna take\nthis experience and win next time![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: Thanks for everything, new kid! Here, take these\nas a token of my gratitude![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: Have your Pokémon chug some Protein so they\ncan smash through their limits! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_reward_00

entries.text: Ahhh, another day, another great battle! Thanks,\nnew kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: I won’t let you win so easily next time! Smash\nthrough your limits![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
Thanks for letting me eke out a win! Really helps
me save face as a battle studies instructor!\c
Why don’t you go look out on the ocean and
soak in your defeat?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: Man, the clubroom sure is full of little rascals!\nAhhh, so much youthful energy![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_00

entries.text: To tell you the truth, I don’t do good with planes.\c\nI really gotta steel myself when I come to\nBlueberry Academy![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
You know you can still train in the middle of
battles, right?!\c
Next time we battle, pay attention to how I’m
moving—it’s how I train my heart and lungs![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] sure is
energized
today,
new kid!\c
It’s gobbling up all the sandwiches I make for
it, too![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
How’s the Meditite I traded you doing?! That li’l
fella loves his punches!\c
Doesn’t matter what he’s facing—he’ll unleash a
huge flurry of punches and smash ’em to bits![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_04
